Demo - Default.description: Default demonstration scenario with no policy changes applied.

Demo - Ottawa BAU.description: Business-as-usual scenario for Ottawa covering both residential and commercial sectors.

Demo - Ottawa Res BAU.description: Business-as-usual scenario for Ottawa residential buildings only.

Demo 2A - Ottawa Res 2030 Electrificatio.description: Ottawa residential electrification scenario targeting heat pump adoption by 2030.

Demo 2B - 2A + Accelerated Retrofits.description: Builds on 2A with accelerated envelope retrofits to improve building performance.

Demo 2C - 2B + Aggressive DR.description: Builds on 2B with aggressive demand response measures to reduce peak electricity demand.
